findings.title: Service uids can query the WSL resolver 10.255.255.254 on lo: open DNS exfiltration channel (violates DESIGN 11.4 'No user gets direct UDP 53')
findings.fix: Render per-uid REJECT for UDP and TCP 53 to every resolv.conf nameserver (and 127.0.0.53 if present) before the '-o lo' ACCEPT for ossrunner/hermes/gatekeeper/ossbox/ossnobody (or restrict the lo ACCEPT to -d 127.0.0.0/8); update --check normalization and tests/unit/ctl/golden/iptables.rules; add UDP+TCP resolver probes per uid to test_egress_per_uid.sh and the doctor per-uid egress check; record in an ADR-0005 addendum.

findings.where: src/ossbot/gatekeeper/control.py:238 (reconcile); kill flag writers src/ossbot/watchdog/tick.py:95, scripts/bin/ossbot-kill, scripts/bin/ossbot-boot-gate
findings.title: Kills that bypass the gatekeeper (watchdog, ossbot-kill/kill.ps1, boot gate) do not invalidate armed|confirmed approvals (DESIGN 12.4)
findings.fix: In ControlService.reconcile(), when a kill flag is observed that control_state has not yet recorded (state != killed or newer flag ts), call approvals.invalidate_armed_confirmed('killed', 'flag') in the same transaction (also at startup) and send an FYI; add test_control_reconcile.py cases for a root-written soft flag while running and a full flag found at startup, asserting the armed approval is invalidated and its confirm token dead.

findings.where: docs/plan/CR-001-lifecycle-up-down.md (user change request, uncommitted); src/ossbot/gatekeeper/control.py, src/ossbot/sandboxd/jobs.py, systemd/*.service, scripts/, src/ossbot/ctl/cli.py, docs/DESIGN.md
findings.title: CR-001 graceful lifecycle up/draining/down (distinct from kill) is not implemented
findings.fix: Phase 1: lifecycle state in the gatekeeper control model (kill overrides), sandboxd drain (no new jobs, drain timeout default 120 s configurable, rest marked interrupted), TimeoutStopSec >= drain+30 s on every ossbot unit with gatekeeper/proxy stopped last, scripts/up.ps1, down.ps1 [-Timeout] [-All], status.ps1, ossctl up|down|status, in-flight public writes never auto-resumed (SUBMIT_FAILED interrupted + fresh-approval Retry), crash-safety e2e that SIGKILLs services and a sandbox mid-job (no duplicate writes), sleep/hibernate monotonic-time handling, fake-Bot-API long-poll reconnect test. Commit the CR file with the implementation and update DESIGN.md (7.5, 7.6, 13). Deferred to Phase 2 and recorded explicitly in PLAN.md: stage re-queue on up (FEAT-006 runner), Telegram /drain /undrain /down /up (FEAT-005), README/SETUP/AGENTS 'Daily use' and lifecycle invariants (FEAT-008).

findings.title: Human title/body edits are stored without policy.check_text
findings.fix: No Phase 1 caller; FEAT-005 Edit title/body must run policy.check_text (confidentiality floor, secrets, disclosure, lengths) before storing an override.
